findings.title: Site upstream can target the loopback admin listener, exposing admin-plane unauthenticated endpoints through the public data plane
findings.impact: A user with write:sites can point a site upstream at 127.0.0.1:<adminPort> and reach unauthenticated admin-plane endpoints (/api/setup/status, /api/auth/login-options, /health) from the internet-facing data plane, bypassing the loopback-only admin bind. When the admin listener is HTTP and co-located, this defeats the network isolation boundary; authenticated endpoints still require a session.
findings.fix_hint: Reject loopback/link-local/private upstream targets unless an explicit, audited operator flag is set; resolve and bind the admin listener to a separate network namespace or require mTLS on the admin plane.

notes: T3-F1 replayed 2/2 on fresh instances: data-plane /api/setup/status=200 and /health=200 via pivot site; direct data-plane request without site=421; admin /api/system via pivot=401.
